title: Chapter 1034
text:
Inside the Black Star spaceship …

"Is that so? Ames has already arrived. Let her stay at my place for a while … Oh? You've already settled her. Good job. I'll reward you with a little red flower when I get back. "

Han Xiao looked at Aurora's angry face on the communicator and chuckled.

After settling Ames down, Aurora immediately contacted Han Xiao and explained the situation. Her tone was filled with resentment … To purposely stand her teacher up and let her deal with it, Black Star was too mean.

"You'd better talk to her, or Her Excellency Dragon Emperor will definitely be even angrier."

"I have my own plans. Treat her well and use your cuteness to calm her down. I'll explain to her when I get back."

Han Xiao hung up after chatting for a while and shook his head with a smile.

Inviting Ames to Black Star Palace was a deliberate move by him to deepen the misunderstanding and make others think that his main body was in the headquarters. At the same time, he could strengthen the armed forces in the headquarters while he was out, mainly to protect Aurora and the others.

After all, there were many ways to do mysticism. Now that Hella had revealed her abilities, there would definitely be people who would perform divination on her. It was hard to say if someone would divine the strengthened life link between Aurora and Hella, so it was never wrong to be more cautious.

Putting this matter aside, Han Xiao pulled out the information the dynasty had sent him a few days ago.

After his Promotion, he had asked the dynasty about the 'God's Trait Transformation' and the 'First Sanctum' and obtained some confidential information.

According to the information, after entering the peak Beyond Grade A realm, one would need to dig deeper into the Super system and the essence of one's genes. When one's life level sublimated to this stage, there would be some changes, and a new sublimation pathway would appear, known as the 'God's Trait Transformation'.

Every step of the transformation was a special sublimation, giving one new strength. It was like the sublimation of life had crossed a certain boundary and given birth to a new 'superpower'. Most peak Beyond Grade As believed that this was an important factor in leading to that unknown higher realm. Meanwhile, the God's Trait Transformation seemed to have no end. Until now, no one had heard of anyone who had completely completed the God's Trait Transformation. It was still a mystery.

When Han Xiao asked about the God's Trait Transformation, the dynasty was not surprised. With Black Star's current status, it was not strange for him to come into contact with this field. Furthermore, Han Xiao had just held the Meeting of the Gods a while ago, so it was very likely that he had heard this term from the other peak Beyond Grade As and turned around to look for more information.

This information cost him some Faction Contribution Points. Not only did it include the introduction, but it also included the dynasty's research on this, as well as the experience and understanding left behind by the previous peak Beyond Grade As. This allowed Han Xiao to have a better understanding of the effects of the God's Trait Transformation.

However, he did not find any other way to obtain God's Trait Transformation Points. It seemed that he could only obtain points through Life Hierarchy Advancement.

However, it was still useful. Han Xiao combed through the information and vaguely discovered a pattern. The God's Trait Transformation Points that came with every Life Hierarchy Advancement was not fixed, and it seemed to depend on many factors.

Although the others did not have an interface and could not quantify their attributes, Han Xiao calculated based on the information and guessed that there might be a few conditions that affected the God's Trait Transformation Points for every Promotion. The highest attribute must exceed 20,000 points, the secondary attribute must exceed 15,000 points, the Energy Rank must exceed 85000 points, the Class Knowledge must be maxed out, the Soul Link to a Universal Treasure, and so on.

Every time these conditions were met, the God's Trait Transformation Points would increase by one every Promotion. He had obtained two points on his first Promotion, which meant that he had fulfilled two of the conditions.

"If I want more points, do I have to be well-prepared?" Han Xiao thought to himself.

Obtaining two God's Trait Transformation Points on his first Promotion was not the best, but it was not bad either. It was just average.

This meant that at the peak Beyond Grade A level, suppressing one's level was the mainstream way to fight. Only by fulfilling more conditions would one gain the most from the Promotion.

"If I'm not wrong, the subsequent Promotion missions might require me to reach a certain level of God's Trait Transformation …"

Han Xiaoxin thought about it and immediately understood where the difficulty lay.

If a normal peak Beyond Grade A did not accumulate enough God's Trait Transformation Points during the Promotion, they would not be able to reach the required level of transformation for the next Promotion. Then, their path would be completely blocked, and they would not be able to continue evolving!

Their strength would be capped because of this!

"No wonder. This difficulty is too high. There can't be any mistakes. Perhaps this is the main reason why all peak Beyond Grade As are unable to step into the higher realms." Han Xiao was speechless.

One wrong step and he would fall into the abyss of no return. It was scary.

However, after thinking about it, he gave up on the idea of suppressing his level for the sake of God's Trait Transformation Points.

The existence of the Mission Completion Card allowed him to ignore all kinds of harsh Promotion requirements …

I don't get many points for one Promotion?

Then I'll just have to Promote a few more times!

Leveling up is my biggest advantage. Suppressing my level is neglecting the essentials. Although the God's Trait Transformation Points were good, the increase of the Promotion was much greater.

Han Xiao's thoughts were very clear.

It did not matter whether the God's Trait Transformation Points were high or not. It was fine as long as he could fight better than anyone!

The information on the God's Trait Transformation Points was obtained smoothly, but the information on the First Sanctum shocked Han Xiao.

Because even the dynasty did not know what it was!

"I only found out that I obtained the [The First Sanctum] Skill Fragment after my Promotion because of the interface. Is that why the other peak Beyond Grade As in history did not obtain this ability, leading to no one discovering this thing?"

Han Xiao was secretly surprised. Even the three Universal Civilizations did not have relevant information. This was probably a major discovery that set a precedent.

What is the Sanctum? It sounds like a location … and since there is a First Sanctum, will there be a Second or Third Sanctum?

"It would be great if [Bold Explorer] could be used on this." Han Xiao felt that it was a pity that this ability could only be used on unknown items and locations. It could not be used on the Skill Fragment in the interface.

Putting away the communicator, Han Xiao looked out of the porthole. It was not dark space outside but a bright sea of light.

This was a certain location in the central area of the Emerald Star Cluster. There was a large cloud of bright nebula filled with gas and dust. The gas was ionized by the radiation of the stars, releasing light. At the same time, the nebula reflected, scattered, and projected the light of the nearby stars in the area. The colors of the entire Star Field were mainly green and red. It looked dreamy and beautiful.

In the universe where most areas were dark, this was considered a rare beauty.

"The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy will appear in this nebula. It's time to set up."

Piloting the stealth spaceship, Han Xiao looked for a place to hide, carrying out the strategy of hiding in the bushes. He planned to hide in the dark and be unaware of the oriole behind.

…

As the date of its birth approached, more and more fleets arrived at this nebula. They were all here for the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy.

Most of these organizations were ordinary organizations. Some were determined to obtain it, while others were just trying. They were on guard against each other as if they were facing a great enemy. However, when they saw the fleets of the two Universal Civilizations arrive, their hearts sank to the bottom.

Ravenlaude came with the dynasty's fleet. Although Sisko only brought his own fleet, he had the background of Ethereal, so the organizations present saw him as being instructed by Ethereal.

With the intervention of two Universal Civilizations, the chances of obtaining the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy became extremely slim. However, no one planned to back out.

After all, they had already come all the way here … Even if they could not obtain it, they had to participate.

A small number of fleets from advanced civilizations, including the Modo Civilization, were not discouraged. On the surface, there were only two Beyond Grade As involved. If the two of them kept each other in check, they felt that they still had a chance.

"You guys act according to the situation."

In the communication channel, Roddick ordered the elite troops made up of a large number of Calamity Grades.

On the other side, in the eyes of Ravenlaude and Sisko, the other competitors were all small fries. They only saw each other as their biggest competitors.

Inside the dynasty's flagship, Ravenlaude looked at Sisko's fleet from afar and narrowed his eyes.

"Sisko didn't bring the Ethereal fleet. He didn't report to Ethereal and wants to snatch it himself. Heh, he's much braver than me."

He originally thought that this trip would be easy, but now that a Beyond Grade A was involved, the difficulty immediately increased significantly.

However, Ravenlaude was not nervous at all. His expression was very relaxed.

Only Sisko came, and Ravenlaude was confident that he could take care of this seven-eyed brat. With his strength, dealing with Sisko was not difficult. This guy was not someone he was afraid of.

For the Universal Treasure promised by the dynasty, Ravenlaude was determined to obtain the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy.

From the current situation, he felt that victory was within his grasp.

On the other hand, Sisko, who was in the opposing fleet, felt troubled.

"Even Ravenlaude is here …"

Sisko's expression did not look too good.

The Calamity Grade who submitted the information on the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy saw this and said, "Your Excellency Star Pupil, the situation doesn't seem to be good for us …"

Sisko forced a smile and comforted him. "Don't worry. Whether we can obtain it or not, I will remember your contribution of submitting the information."

He did not only care about his own strength but also the strength of his race. He tried to cultivate more talents for his race to fight for the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. He did not want to use it for himself but wanted to find a suitable host in his race and create a new strong person for his race.

"I believe in you."

Hearing this, this Calamity Grade who submitted had a look of trust on his face but started to plan in his mind.

He did not join Sisko out of gratitude, but it was not intentional either. It was more of a coincidence.

With the information on the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy in hand, he did not let it get to his head. He knew very well that he would not be able to obtain the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy with his own strength. Therefore, he decided to use this information to find a backer and use their strength to compete.

However, he did not give up completely. If his backer obtained the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, he would steal it for himself if he had the chance. If not, he would just obediently rely on the contribution of the information to rise up the ranks. This way, he would be able to squeeze out the value of this information to a greater extent. It was better than being a gambler and betting all his chips on the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy.

Originally, his target was not Sisko, but he ran into him by chance. After thinking about it, he realized that Sisko's organization was not small. He was also a Beyond Grade A, but his ranking was lower, so the success rate of stealing was higher. Therefore, he changed his target and chose to rely on Sisko.

Ravenlaude and Sisko were hostile toward each other, each with their own motives. However, they did not realize that among the other organizations, there was another Beyond Grade A in a fleet without the symbol of an organization. It was Secret Master.

"Both the dynasty and Ethereal are here …"

A gleam flashed through Secret Master's eyes.

He was stronger than both of them.

However, the enemy was in the open, and he was in the dark. He decided to hide in the dark and wait until both sides were heavily injured before jumping out to take advantage of the situation.

"This plan is feasible. The chances are very high!"

With that in mind, Secret Master cast a bunch of stealth spells on himself, restraining his energy waves and hiding even deeper. A faint sneer appeared on his face.

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy must be mine!

…

Ravenlaude and Sisko faced off, and the other organizations were not chased away. Therefore, they tacitly agreed to set up a space-stabilizing trap in this area that had yet to be activated.

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was a Primal Esper Ability Entity with independent thoughts and the ability to travel through secondary dimensions. This was to prevent it from escaping when it discovered the ambush.

After completing this step, the various organizations waited quietly in this area. It was temporarily peaceful.

The date was very close, and in just a few days, the date indicated by the intelligence arrived.

The various organizations all focused and stared at the area with the coordinates closely, like fishermen waiting for fish to bite the bait.

Other than a few people, most of the people present were not sure if the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy would appear there. They were excited, nervous, and worried.

Buzz!

This time, under everyone's gazes, a dazzling red energy suddenly overflowed from the void and expanded rapidly, forming a red energy cloud in the shape of a fog, exuding a unique energy wave.

When they saw this scene, everyone's spirits were suddenly raised, and their emotions were all boiling!

"This is the right location. The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy has finally appeared!"
